info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cross-Channel Session Dialogue API
info.description: The Cross-Channel Session Dialogue API facilitates seamless interactions across various banking channels by managing ongoing session dialogues. This API allows clients to access and retrieve detailed information about user sessions, enhancing the customer experience by providing contextual insights. Typical consumers include banking applications and customer service platforms that require real-time session data. Use cases include assisting agents with customer inquiries and personalizing user interactions based on session history.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the session dialogue associated with cross-channel interactions. It helps in understanding user behavior and improving communication strategies across various platforms.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to initiate a GET request for session dialogue information in a cross-channel context. The expected format is JSON, and it must comply with the defined schema.

GetCrossChannelSessionDialogueRequest.description: A string representing the request body for the GET operation in a cross-channel session dialogue.

GetCrossChannelSessionDialogueResponse_2.title: Cross-Channel Session Dialogue Response

items.description: A list of session dialogue entries.

sort.description: The sort order applied to the response.

GetCrossChannelSessionDialogueResponse_2.description: This schema represents the response structure for a successful GET request to retrieve cross-channel session dialogue data.

SessionDialogueItem.title: Session Dialogue Item

authenticationLevel.description: The level of authentication for the interaction.

SessionDialogueItem.description: Represents a single entry in the session dialogue.
